messages:
anya: Heads up — 99th latency spiked in us-west-2 around 18:05, sustained for ~10m. p99 went from ~230ms -> ~1.3s :eyes:
vikram: Any quick signal? max_batch hit rates / queueing_time spikes?
anya: Seeing lots of `admission:reject` logs citing max_batch reached. sample:
```
[2026-03-18T18:05:12Z] model=rdw-13B tokens=512 admitted=false reason=max_batch_reached queue_ms=1200
```
Also KV cache hit dropped ~8% and GPU util ~98% across the pool.
maria: That looks like the packing threshold tune we rolled earlier today (pack_threshold=0.92). deploy-bot: rolled config pack_threshold->0.92 @maria 2026-03-18T12:00 :information_source:
leo: We should consider a targeted fallback for latency routes — lower max batch or change admission order. Example quick change:
```
routes:
  latency-critical:
    admission_policy: latency_first
    max_batch_tokens: 1024  # was 2048
```
vikram: Also seeing intermittent NIC tx queuing on node03 in us-west-2, `dmesg` shows TCP stalls. Could be compounding tail.
anya: Running metric queries now, will post p95/p99 and queue hist. (query: `redwood-metrics query "p99(latency) by route" --range 30m`) Graph: https://internal/graphs/abc123
maria: Quick mitigation plan: 1) lower pack_threshold for latency-critical models, 2) set smaller max_batch_tokens on those routes, 3) enable short burst reserved capacity for the affected shard (temporary). I'll open a runbook PR.
vikram: Note cost impact if we reserve more GPUs; but agreed to prioritize SLA while we triage.
leo: Also consider admission-control tweak: prefer starting new batch if current queueing_time > X ms rather than waiting to fill. That reduces throughput but avoids long tails.
anya: I'll collect model token distribution and sample traces (pprof) and attach.
maria: Making the config change in staging now, will canary to shard-7 then prod. ETA 12m.
vikram: I'll dig into node03 NIC and check for driver/firmware issues and sched settings. ETA 30m.
leo: Action list: maria -> config canary (12m), vikram -> node NIC triage (30m), anya -> traces + token dist. If no improvement in 20m we escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: incident created INC-2026-021, assignees: vikram, maria, anya.
anya: Posting perf dumps as soon as uploads finish. Thanks all.
